concept_label: Weekly home return while away for school/work (2011)
value_label_status: official questionnaire/CodeBook binary response labels reviewed; frequencies omitted
mapping_status: questionnaire and CodeBook agree on binary weekly-return item; candidate mapping, denominator and analysis eligibility require review
construct: Whether the respondent attends school or works away from home but usually returns to this household almost every week
value_semantics: Binary weekly-return status; not an ordinal return-frequency scale and not harmonized with 2013
caveat: The 2011 baseline questionnaire asks a binary almost-every-week return question and the CodeBook labels it 1=Yes, 2=No. Do not interpret it as the 2013 three-category frequency measure or combine with the 2020 ba005 interview-address type.

concept_label: Return-home frequency while away for school/work (2013)
source_label: Attend School/Work Away From Home But Return to This Home Almost Every Day/Week
value_labels: 1=Go home almost every day; 2=Go home almost every weekend; 3=Go home once every two weeks or more
value_label_status: official questionnaire/CodeBook response labels reviewed; frequencies omitted
mapping_status: questionnaire and CodeBook response categories reviewed; candidate mapping, denominator and analysis eligibility require review
construct: Respondent-reported frequency of returning to this household while attending school or work away from home
value_semantics: Three ordered categories for 2013 only; no cross-wave harmonized scale is established
caveat: Single-wave candidate for the respondent's return-home frequency while attending school or work away from home. The item does not measure distance, duration away, or current employment. Keep its three original categories; do not combine with the 2011 binary weekly-return item or 2020 ba005.
